_doc: src/shared/training.ts (tool 6 of Lote 1: guided training missions) against contracts/training/missions.json (the lessons, hand-written) and contracts/courses/basic.json (the `course` step). Every step is checked ONLY against frames, never against the input used. A frame is [dt, n, e, alt, yawDeg, armed (0|1), landed (0|1)]: metres from the take-off point (n north, e east), alt = height over the ground, yawDeg clockwise from north, dt = seconds since the previous frame of the step (0 for the first). trainingFrame(TelemetryFrame) derives it (n, e = p[0], p[1]; alt = -p[2]; yaw from the attitude quaternion). `steps` = stepCheck(step, ctx, frame, dt, env): a fresh ctx (all zero / null) for the first frame, the returned ctx for the next. `probes`: one frame against a fresh step. Borders: takeoff is |alt - target| < tol (STRICT), flying = armed and not landed; hold is inside the sphere (horizontal <= tolH and |alt - alt0| <= tolAlt, INCLUSIVE, landed or unarmed = outside) around the position of the FIRST frame of the step, a frame adds its dt to the seconds held only when it and the one before are inside (the first frame of the step and the first one back inside add nothing), leaving sets the count to 0 and done is count >= seconds; reach is the 3D distance <= tol (inclusive); orbit takes the position of the first frame as the centre, a frame is in the ring when rMin <= r <= rMax (inclusive), the angle theta = atan2(e, n) (clockwise from north) accumulates wrapPi(theta - previous theta) between two consecutive frames in the ring (so a jump through ±pi is a small step), leaving the ring sets the angle to 0 and forgets the previous angle, done is |angle| >= 2 pi turns (either direction); yaw is |wrap(yawDeg - deg)| <= tol in degrees (inclusive); land is landed and not armed and the horizontal distance to the point <= radius (inclusive); course runs courseStep (tool 5) with (n, e, alt) and is done when the lap finishes. `progress` is 0..1: takeoff 1 - |error| / alt while flying; hold = held / seconds (it goes back to 0 on leaving); reach 1 - (d - tol) / (d0 - tol); orbit |angle| / (2 pi turns); yaw 1 - error / 180; land 0.5 * closeness (as reach, horizontal) + 0.5 * (1 - alt / alt0), alt0 = max(alt at the first frame, 0.5); course reached / checkpoints; every one but hold is monotonic (the best so far). done forces progress 1. `hint` = the id of the step once idleS >= 20 s (takeoff: withinS), idleS being the seconds since the progress last beat the best by more than 0.002 (dt of every frame added). `scripts`: sequences with the context carried; `done_at` is the 0-based index of the first frame that finished the step (the rest are not stepped); `expect` lists every `every`-th frame (and the last) with its index `i`. `targets`: stepTarget (what the 3D scene and the map mark; hold and orbit need the captured origin). `lesson_runs`: startLesson / lessonStep / retryStep: a step that completes on a frame starts on the NEXT one (its first frame captures its origin); `step` is the number of steps done; a retry gives the step a fresh ctx (the clock keeps running); `from_start` is false when the run began at a later step. `progress`: parseProgress of the text kept under twinsight.training.v1 (anything invalid gives {}), recordRun (best time only from a run that started at the first step and finished, never worse; mid-lesson saves keep the done mark and the best time) and resumeFrom. `integration`: every lesson flown on createSim(22) stepped at 0.01 s with the runner ticked every 0.05 s (the commands a pupil would press are issued when a step starts; the manual leg streams the sticks, the course lap sends fly_to at each waypoint of the route as the simulator golden of tool 5): `time_s` and `step_times_s` are compared within `tolerance.time` (s), the final position within `tolerance.position` (m). Times in seconds. Unity ports the module to pure C# and runs the same file.

probes.name: takeoff: armed but still flagged landed, at the height
takeoff: in the air but not armed, at the height
takeoff: exactly tol below (2.5) is not within
takeoff: exactly tol above (3.5) is not within
takeoff: horizontal position does not matter
reach: exactly tol (1.5) from the point is reached (inclusive)
reach: 3D distance 1.5 with a horizontal and a vertical part
reach: on the ground counts when the point is on the ground
yaw 180: -175 is 5 away through the wrap
land: landed and disarmed on the point
land: disarmed in the air (not landed)
land: exactly radius (3) away is inside (inclusive)
land: in the air over the point

scripts.name: hold: leave the sphere and come back
scripts.note: sphere of 1 m / 0.5 m around the first frame; leaving resets the count to 0 (the bar goes back), the border is inside; done when 5 s were held

scripts.name: hold: a slight drift is fine, a landed frame is outside
scripts.note: landed counts as outside the sphere

scripts.name: orbit: one clockwise lap in 25 degree steps (the 16th frame is at 375 degrees)
scripts.note: the first frame at the centre is outside the ring (r < rMin) and only captures the centre; the angle accumulates from the first frame inside [rMin, rMax]; done once |angle| >= 2 pi

scripts.name: orbit: counter-clockwise also counts
scripts.note: the same lap the other way round: |angle|

scripts.name: orbit: the angle unwraps through ±pi (clockwise from 100 degrees)
scripts.note: the angle passes 180 degrees and comes back at -155: the step is 25 degrees, not -335

scripts.name: orbit: the angle unwraps through ±pi (counter-clockwise from -100 degrees)
orbit: leaving the ring resets the turn
scripts.note: half a lap, out at 20 m (> rMax), back in: the angle starts again from 0, so a further full lap is needed

scripts.name: orbit: going inside rMin also leaves the ring
scripts.note: a pass at 2 m from the centre (< rMin 4) resets the angle

scripts.name: orbit: back and forth cancels out
scripts.note: the angle is the net rotation: 100 degrees forward, 100 back and 100 more back is -100, never a full turn

scripts.name: hint: 20 s without progress
scripts.note: the hint is the id of the step, raised when 20 s went by without the progress beating the best by more than 0.002

scripts.name: hint: takeoff withinS 8 raises it sooner
scripts.note: takeoff { withinS } is the time before its hint

scripts.name: hint: steady progress keeps it away
scripts.note: reach: half a metre every 5 s of a 7.5 m trip

scripts.name: hint: the hold bar going back to 0 does not count as progress
scripts.note: hold: leaving the sphere again and again never beats the best

scripts.name: land: descend, touch down outside then inside the radius
scripts.note: progress is half the closeness (horizontal) and half the descent

scripts.name: land: a landing outside the radius does not finish it
scripts.note: the drone has to take off and land again

scripts.name: yaw: the bar follows the error
course: the lap of the route finishes the step
scripts.note: courseStep on contracts/courses/basic.json from frames only: the take-off starts the lap, the checkpoints go in order, the step is done when the lap finishes; collisions do not end it

scripts.name: course: a route that misses the second ring does not finish
scripts.note: ring 2 (checkpoint 3) is never crossed: the lap stays at 2/7 and the step is not done

targets.name: takeoff: a sphere above the H
reach: a sphere of radius tol
hold before the first frame: nothing yet
orbit before the first frame: nothing yet
orbit: the ring around the captured centre

lesson_runs.name: lesson 1: take off, then hold (a step that completes starts on the next frame)
retry: the step starts again from the drone as it is now, the clock keeps running
resume at step 2 (the saved step): not from the start, so no best time

record_flow.name: finished again in 55 s: the best time stays 40
finished again in 31.5 s: new best
a pass that resumed at a step does not set a time (20 s)
redoing it, step 1 completed: the done mark and the best time are kept
another lesson finished by a resumed run: done, no best time

resume_from.name: a step out of range (the lesson changed): start over
